text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As the hustle and bustle of the morning market settled down and the footsteps of people grew sparse, a small shadow stood in front of the Alces Atelier's shop, which faced a back alley.
text_block_list.orig_text:
朝の市場の活気が落ち着き、
行き交う人々の足音もまばらになる頃。
路地裏に面したアルケス錬金堂の店先に、
小さな影が佇んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Heave ho... Phew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいしょっ……
と。
ふぅ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Now then. It's about time to open up shop...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
と。
そろそろ開店時間だけど……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're here. Right on time. Not bad~
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
来た来た。
時間ピッタリじゃん。
やるねえ～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Now then... the Alces Atelier shop is open for business~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ……
アルケス錬金堂、
開店で～す。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm really glad you came. Rui-chan's away on a business trip, and Iroha tagged along as her bodyguard, so I'm all on my own~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう、
君がきてくれて助かったよ。
ルイちゃんは遠くに出張で、
イロハも用心棒でついてったから、
今日は一人だったんだ～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: So with that... I'm counting on you helping me out today. Oh, and don't worry... you'll be clocking out on time, no overtime. ...Ah, we have a customer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ということで
今日は一日お手伝い
よろしくお願いします。
あ、
定時上がり厳守で
残業ないから
安心して。
……
っと、
お客さんだ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you're already used to dealing with customers, but let me offer you a refresher. Here goes, this is the art of adult-level customer service... Welcome, I'll be right there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
接客は慣れてるだろうけど、
とりま
お手本見せるわ。
いくよ
大人の接客術……
はーい、
いらっしゃいませ。

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Oh my, oh my... young lady, are you helping out in the shop? How admirable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
お嬢ちゃん
お手伝いかい？
えらいねえ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ummm... Yeah, that's right! Onii-chan, try asking her what she needs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっと……
う
ん、
そうだよー
お兄ちゃん、
何が欲しいのか
聞いてみてよ。

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Right, right. My husband has a backache. Do you have any good medicine for that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう。
ウチの爺さんが
腰を痛めてねえ。
何かいい薬はないかい？

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank goodness. Recently, there's been a monster lurking near our village. So then, my husband said he'd chase it away, despite his age. He picked up the spear he used back in the day, and, well... you can imagine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
よかった。
最近、
村の近くに
魔物がすみついてね。
それで、
爺さんが
年甲斐もなく追っ払ってやるってんで
昔使ってた槍を担いだら
あのざまさ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A monster, you say? Sounds scary. Then, how about adding this monster-warding amulet as well? Right, Onii-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
魔物ですか。
それは怖いですね。
じゃあ
こちらの魔物除けの
アミュレットもご一緒にどうです？
ね、
お兄ちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, that sounds nice. Guess I'll take it, too. *sigh* Still, you’re really such a responsible little one. As thanks for helping me make a good purchase... here, have a candy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へえ、
いいじゃないか。
それももらおうかねえ。
はー、
それにしても
本当にしっかりした子だねえ。
いい買い物ができたお礼に。
ほれ。
飴ちゃんあげよう。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーい
ありがとー！

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: I'll come again sometime.
text_block_list.orig_text: また来させてもらうよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay, we'll be waiting. ...Well, that should be about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
お待ちしてまーす。
……
と、
まあ
こんな感じ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, don't treat me like a kid. Did you pay attention at that adult-level customer service back there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
子どもじゃないんだからさ。
さっきの大人な販売術、
見てたでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: When someone comes to buy a "drill", what they want is not a "drill" but a "hole". In other words, a capable salesperson is someone who can show you how to solve a problem. What do you think? Helpful?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ドリルを買いにきた人が欲しいのは
ドリルではなく
『穴』である。
つまり、
問題解決の方法を提示するのが、
できる店員ってこと。
どう？　
参考になった？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh... Well, it'd be a pain to explain to everyone about it, right? Adapting to the situation, look at it like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
まあ
いちいち説明するのも
大変だし？
臨機応変
ってやつ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. For now, let's stock the shelves until the next customer arrives... Huh? Ah, this one goes up there. Hold on a second. Stepstool, stepstool...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
いいや。
とりあえず次のお客が来るまでは
ここの在庫を……
あれ。
ああ、
上か。
ちょっち待ってね。
踏み台踏み台……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks. In situations like these, my real body would be best. But it's not like I'd have the strength either way, so anything heavy would've been impossible regardless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
ありがと。
こういう時は前の体の方がいいな。
でも力ないから
重いのはどっちみち無理か。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That said, it truly is a helpful blessing to have a man around. Hey, why not just join as a regular part-timer? ...Ah, I suppose that's impossible, though. You’re too busy, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱ男の子がいてくれると助かるな。
ね、
いっそレギュラーでバイトはいらない？
……
なんて無理か。
忙しいもんね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, that should do it for goods stocking. Wait, this is bad... Yesterday we managed to land a big contract, so now I’ve got a mountain of paperwork, contracts and whatnot, piling up......
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう、
品出しはこれでよしと。
ってかやばいな……
昨日大口の取引が決まって、
契約書やなんやらの事務作業がめっちゃ溜まってんだよね……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Seriously? That'd be a huge help. Well then, I guess I'll take you up on your offer and leave this to you. Counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
マジ？　
それすごい助かる。
それじゃ、
お言葉に甘えて
ここ任せようかな。
よろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Alright then... Let’s tidy up over here, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ……
こっちも片づけちゃいますか。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, that should be good enough for now. Next up, the ledger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふう、
こっちはこれでよし。
次は帳簿を……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text: んー？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahh, that? It’s in the wooden crates to the left as you enter the workshop. Line up the ones with the same color.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
それはねー、
工房の入って左のとこの木箱。
色が同じやつ並べといて。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふふ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, moderately quiet, with a moderate amount of sound... It's soothing, and above all, it really helps me concentrate...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
適度に静かで、
適度に音がするのって
癒されるし、
なにより集中できるわ～……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Usually, Iroha would be up making a fuss while Rui-chan'd be running wild in response... not that such lively days are bad.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもみたいにイロハが騒いで
ルイちゃんが暴走してる
にぎやかなのも悪くはないけどさ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Aaah... How peaceful. Somehow, I feel like I'm twice as efficient than usual... If it could always be like this, I wouldn’t have to struggle so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
平和だ。
なんか、
いつもの倍くらい効率良い気がする……
ずっとこうなら苦労しないんだけどなあ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Like this, just the two of us... relaxing together... Wait.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなふうに、
彼と二人でまったりと……
って。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, what's up? If you needed something, you could've just called me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん、
どした？
なんかあるなら呼んでくれたらよかったのに。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah... so the customers have dried out. Sorry, my bad, I didn't notice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
お客さん途切れちゃってたか。
ごめんごめん、
気付かなかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's already this late, huh. Yeah, there are no customers, so I guess we've earned ourselves a break. You don’t mind drinking the same thing as me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうこんな時間か。
うん、
お客さんもいないし、
ちょっと休憩しよっか。
飲み物、
私と一緒でいいよね？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Aaaah... This is so soothing... Coffee during a break is just divine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
癒される……
休憩中のコーヒーって
神だ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Here, yours too. The sugar and milk are right over there, help yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
君にも。
砂糖とミルクはそこの使って。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, don't need any. I always drink it black. ...Wait, what's with that look?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はいいよ。
いつもブラックだから。
……
って、
なにその視線。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Just now... you thought: "But she's a kid", didn't you? I keep telling you, I might look like this, but I'm definitely an adult.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
子どもなのにーとか思ったでしょ。
いつも言ってるけど、
こう見えてちゃんと大人だからね、
私。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, that's exactly the way you'd treat a kid I'm speaking of. Besides, this is Rui-chan's special low-caffeine blend. Our guild master even knows how to make a mean cup of coffee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
それが子ども扱いだから。
それにこれ、
ルイちゃん特製ブレンドのローカフェイン。
うちのギルマス、
バリスタもいけるな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't tell me... you were worried about Iroha's body health? Hehe, you're so kind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
もしかして
イロハの体のこと心配してくれてたの？
ふふっ、
優しいんだ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You're really good at paying attention to things like that. That's definitely one of your good points.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうとこにも気を配れるなんて
やるじゃん。
結構モテポイント高いよ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Well, I’m not one to miss details like that. I guess you could see it as this "Onee-san's years of experience".
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
その辺は抜かりないわけよ。
お姉さんの年の功、
ってやつでね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: So, you know... feel free to rely on me a little bit more. I am older than you, after all. For example~
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからさ、
もうちょっと甘えてくれてもいいよ。
年下なんだからさ。
例えば～

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Like when you want a little more sugar and milk in your coffee. Okay? ...Now then, break's over. Let's do our best until closing time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コーヒーにもうちょっと
砂糖とミルクが欲しい時とか。
ね。
……
さて、
休憩終わり。
定時まであと少し、
頑張ろっか。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, good work. We wrapped things up right on time again today. I got so much done thanks to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい、
お疲れ。
今日もバッチリ定時厳守できたよ。
仕事が捗ったのは、
君のおかげだね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: You really were a lifesaver. Thanks. ...Ah, I know, if you want... wanna grab something to eat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと助かったよ、
ありがと。
……
そうだ、
よかったら
ご飯食べてく？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It's kinda lonely eating alone, you know. Young man, come have a drink together with this Onee-san...
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人で食べるの寂しいしさ。
若者よ、
お姉さんに一杯付き合いたまえ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: It'll be fine, don't worry. There’s milk that even a kid’s body can safely enjoy♪ See, the nights are long for adults...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいじょぶだいじょぶ。
子どもの体でも
安心して楽しめるミルクがあるからさ♪
ほら、
大人の夜は長い……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaawn......!
text_block_list.orig_text: だふああ……っ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ......uuu. This kid’s body... is craving sleep... Yet I still wanted... To stay up...fuaa......nnn.........suu......suiu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うう。
子どもの体が
睡眠を欲している……
まだ起きてたいのに……
ふああ……
んん。
……すう
……すう。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} gently laid Sono, who had fallen asleep from exhaustion, on the bed and gently patted her head.
text_block_list.orig_text:
疲れて眠ってしまったソノを
優しくベッドに寝かせ、
優しく頭をなでる
{0}であった。
